'''''The Pulverizer''''' was an [[Asteroid Prospector AP-300]] owned and operated by [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. The vessel was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Niree]]. [[Hema]] and [[Rikap]] were part of the vessel's crew.
